LiteratureCentral_MA.source: Synthetic literature-central model from public conditional-extraction and model-input rows; Woods et al. 2019, doi:10.1103/PhysRevApplied.12.014012; Melville et al. 2020, doi:10.1063/5.0021950
LiteratureCentral_MA.description: Synthetic modeling preset, not a measured material property. epsilon_r input: [10.0]; conditional central loss_tangent input: [0.0033]. epsilon_r uses the ordinary median and loss_tangent uses the log-space median. Assumed-typical and censored upper-bound rows are excluded. Existing 0.002 um source-preset thickness is preserved.
